newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's GDP grew 4.5 percent in 1995 - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran's GDP grew 4.5 percent in 1995 - IRNA.

text.p: Iran's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 4.5 percent in 1995 after 1.6 percent growth in 1994, the official news agency IRNA reported on Monday.
IRNA did not specify whether this was nominal or real growth.

Quoting a Ministry of Economy and Finance report, it said growth in value added in the industrial and mining sectors rose to 5.7 percent from 4.9 percent. Growth in value added in agriculture was up at 3.7 percent from two percent.
The report said value added growth in the services sector slowed to 1.2 percent in 1995 from 2.5 percent.
